clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Michael Garrett awaits a crate bound for the Sepulcher. Gordon Wendham packs field supplies in the Trade Quarter, and you bring them to Garrett for the Forsaken bat network to carry toward Silverpine Forest.

The Forsaken send supplies from the Undercity to outposts such as the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Gordon Wendham packs field supplies in a crate in the Trade Quarter. Moving freight along the ground through blighted forests is slow and leaves it open to ambush by Scourge remnants or wild beasts.

The Forsaken use captive vampire bats, bred and kept by skilled handlers, to avoid dangerous roads. Michael Garrett tends the bats from his roost in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. When you bring him the cargo, it can be strapped to a bat and flown over the hills toward Silverpine, linking the capital with its outposts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate. If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.
Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett. He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine? That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.
